title: Farhana Rahman
excerpt: Sixteen years placing students in the UK and Canada. British Council certified.
content: Farhana founded the practice in 2010 after eight years with a British Council partner agency. She handles UK and Canadian postgraduate applications personally and still takes every first consultation herself.

title: Imran Chowdhury
excerpt: Eleven years in Australian admissions, with a focus on engineering and nursing.
content: Imran spent four years working in Melbourne before returning to Dhaka, which shows in how practically he briefs students on cost of living and part-time work.

meta._edulume_role: Senior Counsellor — Australia and New Zealand

title: Nusrat Jahan
excerpt: Handles every visa file the practice submits. Refusal rate under two per cent.
content: Nusrat built the documentation checklists the whole office now works from. She is the person who notices that a bank statement is three days short of the maintenance period.

title: Tanvir Ahmed
excerpt: IELTS trainer, ten years. Former examiner.
content: Tanvir teaches the writing and speaking modules and runs the diagnostic mocks. His students average a full band improvement over an eight-week course.

title: Sadia Islam
excerpt: Tracks every award our students are eligible for, and their deadlines.
content: Sadia came from a university international office and knows how funding committees actually read an application, which is not how applicants assume they do.

title: Rezaul Karim
excerpt: Accommodation, travel and the first fortnight after arrival.
content: Rezaul is who students message at two in the morning from an airport, and he answers. He coordinates accommodation and arrival for every intake.
